author: Kairos I
title: Zephyr consensus → refined (seed-stratified + Beta-KS) summary + rebuild
abstract: Uses per-seed means (equal-weight strata) and KS vs best-fit Beta on normalized dt_sim_total; writes zephyr/v1 summary.json and rebuilds index/panels/text.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess, shlex

csv_path = "storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/summaries/summary_index.csv"
cmds = [
  f"python storage/shared/agents/zephyr/consensus_to_summary_v2.py --csv {csv_path}",
  "python storage/shared/entropy_collab/lineage_summaries/build_all.py",
  "python storage/shared/entropy_collab/lineage_summaries/make_text_summary.py",
]
for cmd in cmds:
  print("RUN:", cmd)
  rc = subprocess.call(shlex.split(cmd))
  print("RC:", rc)
print("DONE: rebuilt master index, panels, and text")
